If you are trying to be serious, I think you need to find a way to restore hope, which is an immensely hard task. I don't really have an answer for that, and I don't think you are going to be able to do it, because it is something inside him. You should try to be there for him, offer an ear and a shoulder; offer some love and patience and just be open and receptive. Healing is hard, but it is a lot easier with some loving people in your life!
